Format incl. Subpackages

This is an Eclipse p2 update site. It is meant to be used from inside Eclipse, not in a browser.

  1. In Eclipse, choose Help > Install New Software…
  2. Enter https://sebastianruff.github.io/eclipse-bulk-formatter/ as the site
  3. Select “Format incl. Subpackages”, finish and restart Eclipse

Offline install: download the zipped update site.

Source and documentation: github.com/sebastianruff/eclipse-bulk-formatter
